items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: By then I was exposed to most of the big shot leaders such as Joe Oliver--

ctx.x: I just had time to change clothes and go to the stockyard. That one week I did a double shift and after that I said goodby stockyard. That was October, 1924. I haven't been to a stockyard since.
I stayed on this job seven months. By then I was exposed to most of the big shot leaders such as Joe Oliver--
Mr. Blakeney, was that the King Oliver?
